body: This is the body of the modal. It holds any content: text, a form or a list.
outside_off_body: A press outside the dialog does not close it. Use Close or Cancel.
escape_off_body: The Escape key does not close it. A press outside, Close and Cancel still do.
long_body: A paragraph of the terms. The body keeps scrolling while the title above and the buttons below stay where they are, so the user can always reach them.
motion_body: Each motion suits a place: a sheet rising from the bottom, a notice under the top edge, a panel from the side.
